name: preview-card-2a
title: Preview Card 2a: Inset top, flat bottom, compact footer
author: tony <tony@spaceman.sh>
description: A catalogue card for showing a live component preview. The flat-bottom preview from 2b, with the one-line footer from 1a.
docs: Every preview card design exports the same `PreviewCard` component, so you can switch designs by changing the import path. Pass the live preview as children.
